column1: # Chapter 2 — Golgotha prison: remaining guard interruption and reaction beats.
# Missing records only from partial group 129 (00079926-0007BE06).

column2: And where is that idiot $$ピリポ$$, who is supposed to guard this cell in the first place?!
You! Were you hiding again because you were scared?!
Why are you such a coward?!
You're getting on my nerves too!
Gwah-ha-ha-ha! How do you feel, gentlemen?!
Hell, if you're going to kill us, then get it over with!
After committing such $$大罪$$s, you expect to be killed easily...?
That is asking far too much.
You will suffer the endless torments of hell as $$生けにえ$$s to seal the $$大悪神$$!
You fools who prattle about $$愛$$ and $$自由$$!
Be grateful to me for treatment far beyond your station! Gwah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
Make certain these people do not cause any more trouble!!
The $$独房$$ beyond here holds someone of such exalted standing...
someone you are not even fit to stand at the feet of!
Make any more noise, and I will show no mercy!!
